I'm trying my best to avoid going back constantly on production and trying to get things done in one go- many projects have taught me this experience.
I have two things I wanted to ask members here what they think of my idea to help the game's leveling balance and economy count.
In game there will be two modes, sandbox and mission based. Basically Sandbox mode will be operated a switch free function that allows you to build up your faction and explore and do small operations- while mission mode will be operated depending on who provides you missions- thus activating switches preventing you from commencing certain objectives that you normally would do in sandbox mode.
mission mode obviously will handle game progression- such as map expansion, area unlocking and rewards such as hard cash and items. Leveling up will mostly be achieved by mission mode only by defeating enemies and accomplishing big tasks.
Sandbox mode will consist of free roam and small objectives-you will encounter enemies on the street but defeating them will result in very low experience points and rewards, effectively forcing you to do missions if you wanted to level up instead of grinding. Enemies in sandbox mode will also operate on a scaling method after you achieve a set level. Theoretically this will make enemies in sandbox mode more challenging but with your leveling up you will still feel a sense of achievement/advantage providing you better rewards and exp as you go, but still to an extent where grinding will be still be a difficult process.
Thoughts ?

It all depends on your commitment and time. New plugins are released every week so who knows when someone will make an easy plugin to make things like factions (if there isn't one already).
The idea of a sandbox mode is appealing but sounds like a nightmare to make on a large scale to keep it interesting. Mission story would be something I would just focus on and do the sandbox mode after you finished the storyline as an add-on or something.
Laying a good foundation is critical but my experience with multiple projects is that the larger you make it the more you will have to backtrack once you want to fine tune something (even if it is only for bug testing).
General opinion would be that I think this is an ambitious project that will not be completed if you don't commit yourself to it from the beginning. If so my idea would be to stop expanding the world and make the game work in what you have right now.
Good luck!

So far things are going very nicely, the bugs are getting wiped out- and so far from memory 1-2 game crashing ones at least are still present.

Update!
​
Hello again, it's been a while since I've made an update post. I feel the need to address some of the progress being made to this project and I owe it to those who follow this with interest.
As always my development cycle is unpredictable and in combination with real life balancing it's becoming pretty much evident I cannot assume when a demo would be released as there is STILL a lot to be done.
Resolution
​
The project has been updated with new resolution settings, I was having great difficulty with this due to the many plugins that have a hand in this sort of thing. A big thanks to
Lunesis
for providing a fix for me.
Ammunition/Reloading
​
Reloading has at last been completed, we now have a fully functional system where both Player characters and enemies have reloading and ammunition requirements, and to top that off-almost ALL existing battler sprites have reload animations as well as particle effect to further enhance visuals, each animation is uniquely configured depending on the weaponry and even sound effects vary. This would not be possible without
Sir Legna
who loved the idea so much he dedicated a lot of time and effort into it!
Dual Wielding
​
Dual wielding is now functional -although restricted to certain characters and enemies. Dual wielding has some great advantages like more attacks, but suffers from slight handling and ammunition consumption. Dual wielding is only accessible if the user is wielding two of the same weapon ID.
Training
​
We now have a training system that involves the player needing to meet a certain set of requirements from a trainer to be able to unlock additional skills for a tier of weaponry type. So far there are 5 levels of training and each unlocks 2 tiers of that weapon type. This is made possible with the help of
Malik 79
who was very kind enough to add a few parameter and note tags to make this possible!
Vehicle Combat
​
Vehicle combat occurs when the Player/Enemy OR both are in a vehicle, the backrounds will determin the background movements and buffs will apply depending on the situation. This is in very early development but is proving to be a very cool feature!
Skill Point System and perks
​
ESo far there are 3 existing skills -Lock picking, Hacking and Traps. Each time the player gains a level he is granted a point he can spend on either 3 skills, these allow the player to access things such as computers, ATMs, Locks on doors and cars -and detecting/disarming traps. The greater the number of points you have on a skill the higher chance you'll be able to succeed against the level of the computers firewall, lock on a door or a deadly trap.Though these aren't necessary to progress in the game, they are however extremely helpful for gathering loot and experience rewards. There is also an item requirement on some of these obsticals. So far Locks and Hacking is finalized but Traps has become alot more of a hurtle than expected.
Things to look forward to in the future!
​
I continue to strive for an RPG Maker game that can escape the basics provided from the program but often encounter things that sadly cannot be realized. Many plugins out there I want to take advantage of simply refuse to work alongside many other great plugins- it's a very normal thing but I always look to see compromises. Here is a short list of things I hope to get finished.
Player and NPC Vehicles.​

Revised Map/City areas​

UPDATE 2024
Some people have asked me privately about this project and it's current state.
The good news is it's not abandoned.
The bad news is it's currently a stressful mess.
EVENT VEHICLE BEHAVIORS
The primary focus right now is the behaviors of NPC vehicles, currently I have been reworking traffic lights, NPC vehicles and potential enemy vehicle behaviors. Drag has been a great help working on a new plugin that helps give certain events commands dependent on there regions, it's still undergoing bug tests and hopefully soon will be completed with additional features.
TRAFFIC SYSTEM OVERHAUL
The traffic light system has also been reworked entirely into a more hazard free mechanic, alot of fail safes been added to avoid vehicles being stuck. T junctions and cross roads have been frequently tested to ensure that flow of traffic is at acceptable levels.
SPAWNING PERIMITTER
Spawning has been improved- due to RPG Maker having rather poor performances with large maps the best way to optimize performance was to have specific events spawn around the player's whereabouts- events that are too far are removed.
There is however a small hurtle- events sometimes spawn in areas that can cause events to be stuck.
Normally this isn't an issue but due to vehicles using DK large events there are exceptions to fault.
DK large events I will be looking into having updated or replaced with something new.
PLANNED MAP SIZE CHANGES
City areas are expected to be around 125x125 tiles in size. Performance was something I wanted to maintain while also having maps big enough to stretch a few city blocks in. The larger the map the better I can control sequences like car chases and objectives.
EVENT CHASE/ENCOUNTERS
There are two main types of events to be encountered on the streets, events on foot and vehicle events.
Events on foot are thankfully not that much of an issue to get around- there is a variety of plugins that can support features like proximity, field of view and intelligent path finding.
However- vehicles is a much more complicated matter, since RPG Maker has a terrible default approach function, having an abysmal vehicle attempting to chase the player is not acceptable.
Vehicle events are supposed to be a challenging encounter, sometimes you will be required to hunt down an elusive vehicle or fleeing from a perusing police car or gang. There are plugins that provide intelligent path finding but they put a strain on the performance.
This is currently doing my head in.
COMBAT IMPROVEMENTS.
We now have grid formation combat, enemies and party members can navigate to different nodes, this also improved aoe related skills, the only thing left to do in this department is to expand on giving nodes buffs/debuffs and making the enemies more intellegent to seek them out.

UPDATE 2025
Hi everyone, it's been several months since I last posted with an update and just to let you all know that this project is still being worked on. However there is a few factors that are currently slowing things down.
Burnout is a bit of an issue so far- I've been given more responsibilities with my IRL work and more hours which have taken up a large portion of my spare time, I work primarily afternoon to late nights and when work is concluded for the day I'm not always energetic enough to use that time for additional work (the creative sense). So afterwards I occasionally play some games just to kill time with.
On top of that I'm still currently being held up with a few plugins I am needing to proceed with, now normally I would work on something else in the meantime but I want to avoid going back and forth rewriting everything and changing maps up for the 100th time when a game mechanic is changed slightly- I just don't see that as productive and more of double/triple handling.
During April I will however be away for 10 days from my work station to go on a long overdue holiday
But do not threat- this is still a project I am working on.
UPDATES:
New PC
My old PC was just no good to work with anymore so I decided to get a new one made, and with the new hardware I have I can work on this project more efficiently.
EVENT VEHICLE BEHAVIORS
Still using and bug testing drag's new plugin he has helped me with, all that remains is the final part of the plugin to be created that allows vehicles to react to other events and the player in several ways.
TRAFFIC SYSTEM
Traffic system is being further tested to support larger lanes and unique intersections and pedestrian crossings. These are components that help operate the road sections in which regular streets divert to smaller roads or larger highways and freeways.
SPAWNING PERIMETER
While working on the new PC I discovered a bug in my spawn event's page set up.
This is a minor fix where the distance will have to be extended to avoid strange appearances when near edges of the map.
MAP SIZES
Last update I had to make changes to the map sizes and how much can operate on a capped level.
Back then it was due to several factors I cannot be sure of, whether it was my old PC or that RPG Maker simply cannot handle much is now questioned -with my new PC hardware it became apparent that I can make maps larger and more busy without a drop of performance but as a cautious measure I'm going to maintain what I had working for now. If I want this project to be playable I want it to run nicely for anyone who is still running low end PCs to high end.
EVENT CHASE/ENCOUNTERS
I am still waiting on a plugin I've commissioned to be made that would make events path find around city streets on a fairly intellegent level with diagonal movements and behaviors. So far I cannot verify if this is forgotten or something else.
COMBAT
With the new PC I have noticed that combat operates a heck of alot faster. Animations queue up nicely and particle animations operate faster and in accordance with the actual set up with frames and the like. As a result of this some skill animations will need to be adjusted, having to cater to the old speed will not reflect well on todays standards and it just down right doesn't look right.
MAP & REGION TEMPLATES
I never occurred to me before that map making could be done in a much more efficient way by having templates made ready along with the regions aligned with the appropriate tiles.
With this new setup being worked on- maps can be made faster with the exception of structures and other accessories. (Structures would be best to be made custom per map to avoid predictable and repetitive visuals in combination of variety on a map) There will be variety of visuals on some map IDs so that the player can never get bored of seeing the same looking bricks and such.
LAST NOTES FOR THIS UPDATE:
I apologies for the delays and the constant reworks. My mind is set on getting these last few plugins and game mechanics established before moving on to the main development. When working on past RPG Maker iterations and projects of old I had this bad habit of plowing through story progression and poorly play tested game mechanics that had constant changes which just slowed me down and eventually killed my interest in the project. This one has seen massive improvements overtime and I want to make sure that I don't have to go back and forth on.

UPDATE:
Despite my brief period of dismay- my project is still being worked on, it's been a bit of a grind but things are coming together on the core game mechanics I've sought after for so long over the last few months.
So far the traffic system is near completion- only a few small bugs remain and an additional behavior mechanic is left to patch up, this will mean that the street maps will be functional and optimized for a sprawling city. There is one experimental phase that is still being tested and that involves possible overpasses and tunnels, multiple level streets for dynamic city traveling.
I'm convinced my old PC wasn't able to handle large cities and population- but with careful optimization from a very talented programmer there is very likely the possibility of utilizing RPG Maker's biggest available map dimensions- potentially minimizing the numbers of rooms that require teleporting while also reducing events in context with quest consistency.
I have also managed to get a commission in the works that will allow the player to utilize vehicles like no RPG Maker game has ever had done before- so far things are VERY promising and exciting to see
come to life. We are talking vehicle magic like custom movements, interactivity, radio etc. The possibility of acquiring vehicles from anyone be it hijacking. We may yet even be able to have car races and the like!
Once vehicles are operational- NPC vehicles will hopefully be given the same treatment to have unique vehicle related chases, races and combat. This is exciting stuff.
Combat is still being worked on- I'm currently experimenting with grid combat to try and have party members requiring to use party aid consumables requiring specific positioning instead of magically having potions and the like heal from large distances- this could be considered the cost and risk of use for items as opposed to consuming TP or mana points for powerful skills from unrestricted distances.
Weapon durability is a possible consideration also- I am looking at the possibilities to make weapon and armor management a factor in line with the necessity of funds. Alot of RPGs have this issue where money ends up being used for nothing more than buying the best gear towards the end of the game and having a stockpile of money that eventually serves no purpose. This project however will hopefully make money a much more important resource.

UPDATE:
Things have been really busy these last few months which have hindered productivity, though there is slow progress it's been spreaded out very thin considering changes to my work contracts IRL.
Happy to reveal that the plugin I've commissioned the great Eli/Hakuen has been going very nicely- currently in the last stages of bug testing and functionality in terms of how I have it set up in my project. So far I can safely say that we have fully functional mechanics in these features-
• Speed climb
Essentially- when the player drives a vehicle, it will gradually climb to it's maximum speed making transportation around maps much quicker, some vehicles will operate faster than others!
• Reversing
Vehicles can reverse and have there own speed resets, some vehicle types even have reverse beepers!
• Vehicle Combat
Driving vehicles does not excuse combat- you'll even see party members riding bikes or inside a car/truck you name it.
• Diagonal movement
Vehicles just wouldn't operate as nicely without it, diagonal turns are essential at some speeds to make changes in direction.
• Vehicle Health/Destruction
Still under works- but we have functional health bars for individual vehicles, too many collisions can cause a vehicle to abruptly stop, how they detonate is something that is currently being worked on.
• Hijacking/stealing
The player is capable of kicking drivers out of vehicles and taking them for yourself, even non-attended vehicles can be pinched but you'll likely need to play a mini-game or have some other requirement that will be considered during development.
• Types
The project is now capable of having different type of vehicles- each offering unique ways in how they operate or what they can provide to the player being combat stats. I'm aiming to have bikes, cars, vans and trucks -even boats! Even these vehicles are visible during combat!
VEHICLE GRAPHICS
Since this plugin has been in development it was hard to ignore the current state of my vehicle graphics- I have been working occasionally on them and even made diagonal sprites to support them.
These are some that are in development!
